title: Lightweight Onramp Playbook for Partner Listings
content:
Purpose
This is a compact "lightweight onramp" playbook for partners who want a fast-turn, low-friction marketplace listing. Goal: get minimal functional listing live in 3 business days with predictable trial provisioning and telemetry, while preserving later upgrade paths to full-featured listings.

Scope
- Small ISVs, integrations, and consulting partners with limited creative assets
- Listings that require no custom SAML/OAuth at launch (can be added later)
- Target regions: US + EU initially, APAC later

How this differs from full listing checklist (notes)
- Reduced asset requirements: 1 tile image (1024x512), 1 short description, 1 short feature bullet list, 1 contact email. No long-form case studies required.
- Minimal legal vetting: use templated MSA + SOC attestation only for SMB tier; enterprise customers still need full compliance review.
- Shortened QA: smoke tests only (no deep performance benching) unless partner claims SLA.

Preflight acceptance checklist (must pass to publish)
- [ ] Partner account created in publisher console with tax/billing TODOs completed
- [ ] Tile image uploaded (PNG, 1024x512) and icon (128x128) present
- [ ] Copy: one-line tagline (<= 140 chars), 3 bullet features (<= 80 chars each), 300-char long blurb for detail view
- [ ] Trial SKU defined with entitlements and duration (default 14 days)
- [ ] Telemetry endpoint and required telemetry keys configured
- [ ] Privacy/data residency checked for partner claim region(s)
- [ ] Legal template signed by partner for SMB listing (template: SMB-MSA-lite-v2)
- [ ] Support contact verified (email + optional docs link)
- [ ] Smoke test run: purchase flow, trial provisioning, entitlement revocation

Minimal listing copybank (short variants for fast A/B)
- Tagline (options):
  - "Plug-and-play LLM search for your app — ready in minutes."
  - "Low-latency semantic search, pre-tuned for product catalogs."
  - "Embeddings + reranking: ship smarter search faster."

- 3 feature bullets (variants):
  - "One-line integration: SDKs for Node/Python and REST"
  - "Predictable latency — tuned for 99th-percentile under load"
  - "Built-in token-cost optimization via batching & cache"

- 300-char blurb (example):
  "Our connector provides semantic search and vector search tooling for product catalogs and knowledge bases. Ships with SDKs, a managed embedding pipeline, and suggested token-cost settings so your team can launch without custom infra. Trial includes 14 days of dedicated evaluation credits."

Trial SKU / Entitlement model (recommended default)
- SKU: partner-trial-lite-14d
- Duration: 14 days from activation
- Quota: 100k tokens or 10k embeddings (whichever first)
- Auto-convert: manual opt-in (no auto-billing)
- Entitlement flags: [trial_active:true], [metering:limited]

Telemetry & Instrumentation (required minimal fields)
- Required events:
  - listing_viewed (tile_id, region, referrer)
  - trial_activated (partner_id, sku, activation_time, user_email_hash)
  - trial_consumption (partner_id, sku, tokens_used)
  - error_signalled (partner_id, endpoint, error_code)
- Minimum retention: 30d for trial-related events
- Hook: partner must supply webhook URL for trial_activated events; fallback email if webhook missing
- Tagging: every telemetry event must include 'listing_channel:marketplace-light' and 'launch_batch' tag when used in pilot cohorts

Preflight smoke test script (run by GTM / QA)
1) Create partner sandbox tenant via publisher console
2) Activate partner-trial-lite-14d SKU for test user
3) Run a generation/embedding call up to 10k tokens; confirm tokens are deducted and trial_consumption event observed
4) Trigger an intentional 4xx from partner endpoint and confirm error_signalled is received and alerts fire in Slack channel #marketplace-alerts
5) Verify listing tile renders correctly in kiosk (mobile + desktop snapshots)

Rollout & fallback policy
- Phase 1 (pilot): small cohort (10 partners), manual publish by GTM lead
- Phase 2 (scale): enable self-publish for trusted partners with automated preflight checks
- Fallthrough: if trial provisioning fails, listing remains visible but shows "Request trial" CTA that routes to partner contact instead of one-click activation
- Escalation: if telemetry missing after publish for 48h, automatically unpublish and notify partner + GTM owner

Customer-facing CTA and microflows (suggested)
- CTA primary: "Start 14‑day trial — no card required"
- Secondary (if trial provisioning blocked): "Request demo / trial" linking to partner contact form with prefilled partner_id
- Post-trial nudge: email sequencing templates (4 touchpoints)

Legal & data notes (minimal)
- Use SMB-MSA-lite-v2 for initial publish; escalate to full MSA for enterprise deals
- Data residency: partner must declare if they will send EU-only PII; if yes, route listing to EU-only regions and flag for compliance review
- KMS/HSM: not required for SMB listing; enterprise customers will need customer-managed keys

Operational runbook (short)
- Owner: GTM publisher (default: Maya Rivera)
- SLA for partner response during onboarding: 3 business days
- Unpublish triggers: repeated billing failures, telemetry blackout >48h, legal red flags

Copy tests & metrics to watch
- Primary success metric: trial activation rate (target >= 18% for pilot cohort)
- Secondary: trial->paid conversion (target >= 2.5% within 60 days), average tokens consumed during trial (for SKU sizing)
- A/B tests to run: 2 taglines, 1 CTA color treatment, presence/absence of pricing snippet

Open questions / TODOs (working notes)
- Decide whether to support 7-day trial in APAC due to local pricing/credit rules (action: Jonah to check marketplace policy by 2025-09-12)
- Confirm default metering units for embeddings vs. text generation (action: Engineering to confirm event schemas)
- Lightweight legal template needs a short privacy addendum for EU data (Priya drafting)

Quick references
- Lightweight onramp Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/marketplace/onramp-lightweight
- Publisher console quickstart (internal): GHN-3012

Notes to self:
- Keep this doc intentionally lean — the goal is frictionless listing, not replacing enterprise onboarding workflows.
- Expect to iterate copy based on pilot analytics in the first 30 days.
- If pilot shows unexpected load, pause new publishes and coordinate with infra (pager: infra-vectors).

-- end of draft --
